input.objective:
Launch Reel (REEL) with a Uniswap v4 hook on Sepolia, paired with ETH.
Token: Reel (REEL), the standard launch token: 1,000,000,000 supply, 18 decimals, plain transfers, no owner functions.
The hook does exactly what the creator describes below, and nothing else.
In the creator's own words: <description>every time someone buys, 2% of the eth goes into a prize pot. once an hour the pot is given to a random buyer from that hour, weighted by how much they bought. no team wallet, no pause button.</description>
No owner functions, no backend signer, no upgrade path.
Fees are always taken from the ETH (pair currency) side, never from REEL; a fee the PoolManager cannot pay directly is minted as a claim the recipient can redeem.
Enable beforeInitialize (required by the IMD launch factory) and only the callbacks the behavior above needs. Take the PoolManager as a constructor argument. Owner, if any, is $owner.
Pool: 50% of my 90% share seeds the pool; the remainder goes to the paying wallet.
Composed with The Hooks Store.
